description: In the term model of a complete consistent set \(S\), interpret \(f([t_0],\ldots,[t_{k-1}])\) as \([f(t_0,\ldots,t_{k-1})]\), and let \(R([t_0],\ldots,[t_{k-1}])\) hold exactly when \(R(t_0,\ldots,t_{k-1})\in S\). These interpretations are independent of representatives.
